name: theme-switcher
description: Client-side palette switcher UI with dropdown selector and localStorage persistence

ai.whenToUse: Use when the project has themeSwitcher enabled and multiple palettes are available. Provides a floating UI for users to switch between palettes at runtime.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use if the project only has one palette or if palette switching should be hidden from end users. Not needed for admin-only theme controls.
